final_review.behavior: Recomputes the encoded bytes of every Request, Response and shared enum fixture and compares them with the frozen EXPECTED hex table; on mismatch it prints a replacement table and instructs the developer to bump PROTOCOL_VERSION.
final_review.failure_caught: Any change to the bincode encoding of a shared type without a protocol version bump, so peers built from different sources decode each other's frames as different messages.
final_review.criticality_reason: crates/ovrcr-protocol/src/wire.rs:1992-2006 encodes the fixtures; a silent layout change makes cross-build decode misread requests (a major workflow failure).
final_review.signal_reason: Exact golden bytes over the whole message surface, so it rejects any encoding drift; it is encode-only (wire.rs:844-850) and performs no decode or validation, so it cannot be S=4 and the decode half rests on sibling round-trip rows.
final_review.uniqueness_reason: No other reviewed test covers the complete encoding surface; sibling round-trip tests only cover the decode direction.
final_review.fidelity_reason: Production encode over the real types, but no peer decode (the version fence is tested separately in codec).
final_review.recommendation_reason: The only byte-level pin of the shared message surface; kept for the encoding half of the wire contract.

final_review.recommendation_reason: Grounded behavioral protection with no complete subsumption; keeps its place.
